title: Refined Spacetime
text: Only a Large Alchemical Reaction Pool can react 10 B of Dilute Spacetime, one Time Warp Point and one Spatial Fold Point into 1 B of Refined Spacetime, with a Spacetime Spell Core in its catalyst floor. A Primitive Reaction Cauldron cannot perform this conversion.

Refined Spacetime has denser, stronger flowing light, but cannot form infinite sources or provide unlimited extraction from Liquid Crystal Balls. A Rough Alchemical Energy Core can catalyze 1 B into one Time Microcore and one Space Microcore together.
